I am an old woman with only this small piece of land in Mwanza, and at my age I cannot waste money on expensive chemicals from the shop. My children and grandchildren will help me work this plot with our own hands, just as we have always done, and we will spread manure from our few goats and chickens to keep the soil strong. We will plant the seeds we saved from last season because they have never failed us, and we do not need sprays or pipes from the lake to grow our food.
